boundsMethod.childGeometryBoundingBox: Raw POSITION accessor min/max before any node transform; size is max-min and centerOffset is (min+max)/2.
boundsMethod.overallBoundingBox: Union of descendant mesh bounding boxes after descendant node transforms, excluding the top-level part node transform.
boundsMethod.scenePlacedBoundingBox: Union after all node transforms, including the top-level part node transform.
